units.rawText: Also, Professor, don't you think this "High-Order" Entropic had almost zero hostile intent?

spans.text: Also, Professor, don't you think this "High-Order" Entropic had almost zero hostile intent?

units.rawText: We've wrecked a lot of Entropic hives along the way here, but they were all composed of the most basic Entropics surrounding a somewhat higher-order Entropic.
units.displayText: We've wrecked a lot of Entropic hives along the way here, but they were all composed of the most basic Entropics surrounding a somewhat higher-order Entropic.

units.rawText: Despite being the highest-order Entropic here, she had hardly any subordinates around to protect her...

units.rawText: Still, time is limited, and all we can do is keep pursuing her.

units.rawText: Yeah, we can't let her go.
